name: WARNING: Taqueria Birria de Res & Consomé (Heavy Tallow Fat & Chili Oil Layer)
whyItWorks: Beef or goat stewed for hours with intense guajillo and ancho chiles, cloves, allspice, and tallow. The dipping consomé features a thick floating layer of rendered red chili tallow grease that overwhelms pancreatic lipase digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid Birria and Quesabirria. Order Caldo de Pollo (chicken soup) for gentle, clear hydration.
